mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (name, kanaName, nickname, email, region, age, gender, created_at, remark, is_deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{kanaName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{region}, #{age}, #{gender}, NOW(), #{remark}, false)
INSERT INTO student_courses (student_id, course_name, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name = #{name}, kanaName = #{kanaName}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, region = #{region}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
